title: c64 leaves
summary: Reviews: c62's Flow-Lenia ecology (S claim: Supported, E by construction; patch claim: Supported for I, X, E, D below gate on seed 24), c43's CIPS consumer (Contradicted: consumers persist with eating off), c46's hunting ecology (Weak: D and E on different kinds). Findings: the predator gate is all-or-nothing (partial gates and a 10% floor leave starved predators alive); dt/2 keeps the Flow-Lenia ecology on 2 seeds; predators fuse more than they divide; annular repulsion and predator dilution negative; prey's extra splits are a density effect; averaged predator trait shows no selection, max-share transport gives a weak positive on 3 seeds (Q:flow-lenia-sampled-trait, open for a longer run with split fidelity). Synthesis at 09:25.
